# Cherry Studio adaptation boundary

The Control Center does not vendor or execute Cherry Studio as a runtime. Files listed in `../../provenance/cherry-source-inventory.json` are adapted against Cherry Studio commit `13687df354e9845c7e2b6d155eac6a9171f6a533` and are covered by the root `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`.

An upstream refresh must compare each inventoried source path, port relevant behavior deliberately, update its modification record, and rerun the visual and behavioral suites. Wholesale subtree replacement is prohibited because the target uses DSH slots, RPC, persistence, credentials, and styling rather than Cherry's Electron services.
